units: <cite ref="Menachot 88a:5">Men. 88ᵃ</cite> <he>ב׳</he> or <he>בֵּירוּצֵי המדות</he> the quantities which remain, when filling from a brimful measure into smaller ones.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shekalim 4:2:7">Y. Shek. IV, 48ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>לב׳</he> goes to the collection of &c.
<cite ref="Yoma 2a:7">Ib.</cite> <he>בירוצי לח</he> the remnants of the overflow of liquids, <he>ב׳ יבש</he> those of dry things emptied over.
